lastCommit.message:
OTA-1819 — the presentation says when it opened

Telemetry only. One production seam, one existing word, no touchPath change.

⚠ EVERY SIGNAL THIS INSTRUMENT HAD WAS KEYED TO A TOUCH, AND A CLASS H INTERVAL
HAS NO TOUCHES. Natural freeze #1 (bundle mu19cjefamkg, iPhone SE 3rd gen, iOS
26.5.2, hal) ended with a COMPLETE T0→T5 chain — travel to Iskan-Veil, done at
13:06:29.881Z — and then 26.08 s of nothing, while the owner pressed a visible
"Got it" about twenty times and the JS thread stayed alive enough to write its
own AppState line at 13:06:55.959Z. Zero terminal root-only runs, unlike Class
G's 19/24/16/4. T0, `content` and M0 are all touch-keyed, so in exactly the
interval that matters every one of them is silent by construction. No amount of
touch telemetry can answer this; a presentation EDGE can.

WHAT IT RECORDS. Mount/unmount for exactly three event-relevant presentations,
by bounded identity: chapter:<phase> and fork:<id> (both native <Modal>, owned by
App.tsx) and hint:combat_readout (an in-tree overlay). The edge rides OTA-1814's
existing `pres` stage with interaction id 0 — `nextId` starts at 1, so 0 can
never collide and reads as "this record belongs to no touch". `append` already
persists on EVERY entry through the same coalesced path the touch stages use, so
the edge is durable with no touch before or after it. No new storage key, no new
timer, no second diagnostic architecture.

WHAT `mount` MEANS. The authoritative React predicate went from absent to
present. It does NOT mean UIKit finished presenting — that is the very gap under
investigation, and an instrument that assumed the answer would be worthless.

⚠ TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE INHERITED PREMISE, stated rather than absorbed. The
brief located chapterCard/pendingFork as ExplorationScreen state; they are
gameStore fields. And ChapterCardOverlay/StoryForkOverlay are not rendered by
ExplorationScreen at all — they live in App.tsx:1209-1213, above the screen
router. The one-file plan survives because the store fields are globally
readable, but the consequence is real and is handled: the seed is silent, so
arriving with a card already up is not recorded as its mount and leaving with one
still up is not recorded as its unmount. KNOWN LIMIT: an edge occurring while the
player is on another screen is not observed.

PROCESS BOUNDARY. A mount with no unmount before process death cannot read as one
native instance spanning two boots: the prior-boot trace and the live ring are
separate arrays printed under separate headings, and this boot's sequence
restarts at 1. Asserted, not assumed.

NATIVE: no. GAMEPLAY: no. LAYOUT: no. POINTER-EVENT: no. RESPONDER CLAIM: no.
MODAL BEHAVIOR: no. PRESENTATION OWNERSHIP: no. NAVIGATION: no. STORY/QUEST: no.
PERSISTENCE ARCHITECTURE: no. NEW TIMER: no. NEW STORAGE KEY: no.

FREEZE REPAIR CLAIMED: NO. Apple-freeze causation remains UNKNOWN, and
FirstTimeHint stays exonerated and untouched.

Validation: new suite 21/21; OTA-1813/1814/1818 + 1819 together 115/115; 22/22
source gates by exit code; typecheck:ci clean; tests ratchet at baseline 201;
lint clean; fast surface 1364/1364 suites, 14,518 passed. Four negative controls
each detected its defect — observer removed (2 red), wrong identity (1 red),
touch-dependent persistence (2 red, including the cross-boot recovery test), and
reversed edge order (2 red) — every one restored md5-verified, touchPath.ts back
to aa46ceeb04d7d11add3fc0cae2f2312a with zero residue.
